title: Reed beds near the road to Multan… | Folio 6 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
Reed beds near the road to Multan. A young prince, shaking with fever, has thrown his club and missed. His spear is in the lion's chest, and his arms are too weak to hold it. The spear breaks.

The full story: Folio 6: The Sultan and the Lion — on our channel and on every podcast app.
